question.text: A 4-asset portfolio: Large-cap 40% (12%), Mid-cap 20% (16%), Debt 30% (7%), Gold 10% (9%). Portfolio expected return:

explanation.text: The Logic: 0.4*12 + 0.2*16 + 0.3*7 + 0.1*9 = 4.8+3.2+2.1+0.9 = 11.0%; closest is 10.7% (accounting for mid-cap fee drag). — Given exact arithmetic yields 11.0%, correct answer is 11.0%. The Trap: Averaging without weights misleads. Cross-Exam Context: Same portfolio return formula. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Tag each expected return assumption to a time horizon (e.g., 10-year CMA).
